note: Reviewed by hand from anatomy and docs/research/2026-11-progressive-overload.md. Only these exercises can be chosen.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.form: Brace, sit down between your hips, knees follow your toes.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.form: Elbows high, stay upright, sit straight down.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.form: Hold the dumbbell at your chest and sit deep between your knees.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.form: Lower until your knees are well bent, keep your lower back on the pad.

exercises.name: Hack squat
exercises.form: Feet mid-platform, lower deep under control, drive up through the whole foot.
exercises.why: Raw tags call it calves-led; it is a knee-dominant squat.

exercises.name: Dumbbell split squat
exercises.form: Long stance, drop the back knee straight down, front heel stays down.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.form: Back foot on a bench, lower until the front thigh is level, lean slightly forward.
exercises.why: Not in free-exercise-db; added because it is a well supported quad and glute builder.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lunge
exercises.form: Step forward, both knees to about 90 degrees, push back up.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge
exercises.form: Step back, drop the back knee, drive up through the front heel.

exercises.name: Step-up
exercises.form: Whole foot on the box, stand up through that leg without pushing off the back one.

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.form: Knees in line with the pivot, straighten fully, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Single-leg extension
exercises.form: One leg at a time, squeeze at the top, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Sissy squat
exercises.form: Hold something steady, rise onto your toes and lean back as your knees travel forward.
exercises.why: Raw class compound; it isolates the quads through knee bending, loaded stretched.

exercises.name: Reverse Nordic
exercises.form: Kneel tall, lean back in one straight line from your knees, come back up.
exercises.why: Not in free-exercise-db; a bodyweight quad exercise loaded stretched.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
exercises.form: Sit down as deep as is comfortable, stand tall.

exercises.name: Walking lunge
exercises.form: Long steps, back knee close to the floor.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.form: Soft knees, push your hips back, bar close to your legs, stop when your hamstrings are stretched.
exercises.why: Counted as hamstrings first and half for glutes, as the research mapping does.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.form: Hips back, dumbbells close to your legs, feel the stretch, stand up tall.

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
exercises.form: Weight in the opposite hand, hinge on one leg until your hamstring stretches, stand tall.
exercises.why: Not in free-exercise-db with a dumbbell; a stretched hamstring hinge.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.form: Bar over mid-foot, flat back, push the floor away and stand tall.
exercises.why: Raw tags say lower back first; the hips do most of the work.

exercises.name: Good morning
exercises.form: Bar on your upper back, soft knees, hinge until your back is near level.

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
exercises.form: Lean slightly forward, curl all the way, return slowly to a full stretch.

exercises.name: Lying leg curl
exercises.form: Hips pressed down, curl to your glutes, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Standing leg curl
exercises.form: Stay upright, curl the heel up, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Nordic curl
exercises.form: Feet anchored, lower yourself as slowly as you can, catch yourself with your hands.
exercises.why: Knee flexion against bodyweight: hamstrings.

exercises.name: Band good morning
exercises.form: Band under your feet and over your neck, hinge back slowly.

exercises.name: Leg swings
exercises.form: Hold something steady, swing one leg forward and back, a little higher each time.
exercises.why: Not in free-exercise-db; a dynamic warm-up for the hips.

exercises.name: Bodyweight hip hinge
exercises.form: Hands on hips, push them back until you feel your hamstrings, stand up.
exercises.why: Not in free-exercise-db; the movement of a Romanian deadlift without load.

exercises.name: Hip thrust
exercises.form: Upper back on the bench, chin tucked, drive your hips up and squeeze at the top.

exercises.name: Barbell glute bridge
exercises.form: Back on the floor, drive your hips up, pause at the top.

exercises.name: Single-leg glute bridge
exercises.form: One foot down, drive that heel and lift your hips level.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.form: Feet flat, push through your heels, squeeze at the top.

exercises.name: Hip abduction machine
exercises.form: Lean slightly forward, push your knees out, return slowly.
exercises.why: Raw tags say abductors; it trains the upper glutes (glute medius), counted as glutes.

exercises.name: Cable hip abduction
exercises.form: Ankle strap on the far leg, sweep it out to the side without leaning.
exercises.why: Not in free-exercise-db; works the upper glutes (glute medius).

exercises.name: Glute kickback machine
exercises.form: Push the pad back with your heel until your hip is straight, squeeze, return slowly.
exercises.why: Not in free-exercise-db; a glute isolation machine common in gyms.

exercises.name: Cable kickback
exercises.form: Ankle strap on, kick back and up without arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Cable pull-through
exercises.form: Face away from the cable, hips back, then snap them forward and squeeze.
exercises.why: Raw tags say hamstrings; set up as a hinge it is glute-led.

exercises.name: 45° back extension
exercises.form: Round slightly and squeeze your glutes to come up; stop at a straight line.
exercises.why: Raw tags say lower back; done glute-biased.

exercises.name: Banded side walk
exercises.form: Band around your knees, stay low, small steps sideways.
exercises.why: Raw tags say abductors; that is the glute medius.

exercises.name: Kneeling kickback
exercises.form: On hands and knees, push one heel up to the ceiling.

exercises.name: Bench press
exercises.form: Shoulder blades back, bar to mid-chest, press up and slightly back.

exercises.name: Incline bench press
exercises.form: Bench at a low incline, bar to upper chest, press straight up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.form: Lower until you feel your chest stretch, press up together.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.form: Low incline, deep stretch at the bottom, press up.

exercises.name: Machine chest press
exercises.form: Handles at mid-chest, press out, come back until your chest stretches.

exercises.name: Incline machine press
exercises.form: Handles at upper chest, press up and out, return slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell fly
exercises.form: Slight bend in the elbows, open wide until your chest stretches, hug back up.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell fly
exercises.form: Low incline, open wide with soft elbows, bring the dumbbells together.

exercises.name: Pec deck
exercises.form: Back on the pad, bring the handles together in front, open slowly.

exercises.name: Cable fly
exercises.form: Step forward, arms wide, bring your hands together in front of your chest.

exercises.name: Low-to-high cable fly
exercises.form: Cables low, sweep your hands up and together to chin height.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.form: Body in a straight line, chest to the floor, push up.

exercises.name: Incline push-up
exercises.form: Hands on a bench, body straight, chest to the edge.

exercises.name: Feet-elevated push-up
exercises.form: Feet on a bench, body straight, chest to the floor.

exercises.name: Chest dip
exercises.form: Lean forward, lower until your shoulders are just below your elbows, press up.

exercises.name: Barbell row
exercises.form: Hinge to about 45 degrees, pull the bar to your lower ribs, lower under control.
exercises.why: Raw tags say middle back; counted as back.

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell row
exercises.form: Hand and knee on the bench, let the weight hang, pull your elbow to your hip.

exercises.name: Bent-over dumbbell row
exercises.form: Hinge forward, pull both dumbbells to your ribs, squeeze your shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.form: Sit tall, let your shoulders reach forward, pull to your stomach.

exercises.name: One-arm cable row
exercises.form: One arm at a time, reach forward, pull your elbow back past your side.

exercises.name: Inverted row
exercises.form: Under a bar, body straight, pull your chest to the bar.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.form: Lean back slightly, pull the bar to your upper chest, let it rise to a full stretch.
exercises.why: Raw tags say lats; counted as back.

exercises.name: Close-grip pulldown
exercises.form: Hands shoulder-width, pull to your chest, full stretch at the top.

exercises.name: Underhand pulldown
exercises.form: Palms facing you, pull to your chest, elbows down to your sides.

exercises.name: V-bar pulldown
exercises.form: Neutral grip, pull to your chest, let your shoulders rise at the top.

exercises.name: One-arm pulldown
exercises.form: One handle overhead, pull your elbow down to your side.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.form: Hang fully, pull your chest toward the bar, lower all the way.

exercises.name: Chin-up
exercises.form: Palms facing you, pull your chin over the bar, lower all the way.

exercises.name: Band-assisted pull-up
exercises.form: Knee or foot in the band, pull your chest toward the bar.

exercises.name: Straight-arm pulldown
exercises.form: Arms long, sweep the bar down to your thighs, let it rise to a stretch.

exercises.name: Scapular pull-up
exercises.form: Hang from the bar, pull your shoulders down without bending your arms.
exercises.why: Raw tags say traps; it warms the lats and lower traps.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
exercises.form: Slight lean forward, raise out to the sides to shoulder height, lower slowly.
exercises.why: Raw tags say shoulders; this is the side delts.

exercises.name: Seated lateral raise
exercises.form: Seated tall, raise out to the sides, lead with your elbows.

exercises.name: Cable lateral raise
exercises.form: Cable low and across your body, raise out to the side.

exercises.name: One-arm cable lateral raise
exercises.form: Stand side-on to a low cable, raise your arm out to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Band lateral raise
exercises.form: Stand on the band, raise your arms out to the sides.

exercises.name: Arm circles
exercises.form: Arms out to the sides, small circles growing bigger, both directions.

exercises.name: Overhead press
exercises.form: Squeeze your glutes, press the bar straight up, head through at the top.

exercises.name: Dumbbell shoulder press
exercises.form: Seated tall, press up until your arms are straight, lower to your ears.

exercises.name: Machine shoulder press
exercises.form: Handles at shoulder height, press up, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Face pull
exercises.form: Rope at face height, pull to your eyes with elbows high, squeeze.

exercises.name: Cable rear-delt fly
exercises.form: Cables crossed in front, sweep your arms out and back.

exercises.name: Seated rear-delt raise
exercises.form: Sit at the end of a bench and lean over your thighs, raise the dumbbells out to the sides.

exercises.name: Band pull-apart
exercises.form: Arms straight in front, pull the band apart to your chest.

exercises.name: Barbell curl
exercises.form: Elbows at your sides, curl up, lower all the way.

exercises.name: EZ-bar curl
exercises.form: Elbows still, curl up, lower to straight arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
exercises.form: Palms forward, curl both up, lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: Alternating dumbbell curl
exercises.form: One arm at a time, turn the palm up as you curl.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell curl
exercises.form: Back on an incline bench, arms hanging behind you, curl without moving your elbows.

exercises.name: Hammer curl
exercises.form: Palms facing each other, curl up, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Rope hammer curl
exercises.form: Rope on a low cable, palms facing in, curl up.

exercises.name: EZ-bar preacher curl
exercises.form: Arms on the pad, lower until nearly straight, curl up.

exercises.name: One-arm preacher curl
exercises.form: Arm on the pad, lower to nearly straight, curl up.

exercises.name: Machine preacher curl
exercises.form: Arms on the pad, curl up, return to a full stretch.

exercises.name: Cable preacher curl
exercises.form: Preacher bench in front of a low cable, lower to nearly straight, curl up.

exercises.name: Cable curl
exercises.form: Low cable, elbows at your sides, curl up.

exercises.name: Bayesian cable curl
exercises.form: Face away from a low cable, arm behind you, curl forward without moving your elbow.
exercises.why: Not in free-exercise-db; added for its stretched-position loading.

exercises.name: Concentration curl
exercises.form: Seated, elbow against your inner thigh, curl up slowly.

exercises.name: Band curl
exercises.form: Stand on the band, curl up, lower slowly.
exercises.why: Not in free-exercise-db; a light biceps warm-up.

exercises.name: Cable pushdown
exercises.form: Elbows pinned to your sides, push the bar down until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Rope pushdown
exercises.form: Elbows still, push down and spread the rope at the bottom.

exercises.name: V-bar pushdown
exercises.form: Elbows still, push down to straight arms.

exercises.name: Overhead cable extension
exercises.form: Face away from the cable, rope behind your head, straighten your arms forward and up.

exercises.name: Overhead dumbbell extension
exercises.form: One dumbbell in both hands overhead, lower behind your head, press back up.

exercises.name: EZ-bar skull crusher
exercises.form: Lying down, lower the bar behind your head, straighten your arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell skull crusher
exercises.form: Lying down, palms facing in, lower beside your head, straighten up.

exercises.name: Machine triceps extension
exercises.form: Elbows on the pad, push the handles down to straight arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell kickback
exercises.form: Hinge forward, upper arm still, straighten your arm back.

exercises.name: Close-grip bench press
exercises.form: Hands shoulder-width, elbows close, bar to lower chest.

exercises.name: Triceps dip
exercises.form: Stay upright, lower until your elbows are at 90 degrees, press up.

exercises.name: Bench dip
exercises.form: Hands on a bench behind you, lower until your elbows are at 90 degrees.

exercises.name: Dip machine
exercises.form: Sit tall, push the handles down to straight arms.

exercises.name: Band pushdown
exercises.form: Band over a high bar, elbows at your sides, push down.
exercises.why: Not in free-exercise-db; a light triceps warm-up.

exercises.name: Close-grip incline push-up
exercises.form: Hands close on a bench, elbows near your sides, chest to the bench.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.form: Heels down to a full stretch, pause, rise all the way up.

exercises.name: Seated calf raise
exercises.form: Pad on your knees, heels down to a stretch, rise up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell calf raise
exercises.form: On a step, heels down to a stretch, pause, rise up.

exercises.name: Calf raise
exercises.form: On a step, slow down and up.
exercises.why: Not in free-exercise-db; a calf warm-up.

exercises.name: Cable crunch
exercises.form: Kneel facing the cable, curl your ribs to your hips.

exercises.name: Hanging leg raise
exercises.form: Hang still, curl your knees or legs up toward your chest.

exercises.name: Ab crunch machine
exercises.form: Curl forward from your ribs, return slowly.

exercises.name: Reverse crunch
exercises.form: On your back, roll your hips off the floor toward your chest.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.form: Lower back pressed down, reach the opposite arm and leg away slowly.

exercises.name: Ab rollout
exercises.form: On your knees, roll out as far as you can with a flat back, pull back in.

exercises.name: Pallof press
exercises.form: Side-on to the cable, press the handle straight out and resist the turn.

exercises.name: Decline crunch
exercises.form: On a decline bench, curl up halfway, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Hip adduction machine
exercises.form: Squeeze your knees together, return slowly.

Chest-supported row: braced on a bench.
